samples.summary: New crash path: TextEditor.siblingsOf resolves the parent table with doc.getBlock (throws), unlike the editor.ts twin which deliberately uses findBlock
samples.evidence: packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:2890 `const tableBlock = this.doc.getBlock(info.tableBlockId);` — `getCellInfo` reads `getActiveLayout().blockParentMap`, which is only as fresh as the last layout pass. This file already treats that map as routinely stale: packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:2971-2978 wraps arrow handling in try/catch with the comment "Stale blockParentMap data (e.g. table rows removed by remote edit)", and `Doc.getBlock` throws when the id no longer resolves (packages/docs/src/model/document.ts:220-266 / findBlock returning undefined). `handleTab` (2699-2707), `handleIndent` (2762) and `handleOutdent` (2779) have no such guard, and before this change the cursor-only path never consulted the parent map at all — so a Tab/Cmd+] with the caret in a cell of a table deleted by a peer now throws out of the keydown handler mid-gesture. The diff's own editor.ts copy documents the opposite choice (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1632-1641, `findBlock`, "rather than throw out of the middle of an indent gesture"); the fix belongs on the new text-editor.ts code (use findBlock + optional chaining).

samples.summary: Switching the multi-block branch from document.blocks to getContextBlocks() also changes behaviour for the walker's other consumer, applyListKind (bullet/number toggle)
samples.evidence: packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:2744-2755 (`applyListKind`) is an out-of-diff consumer of `forEachBlockInSelection`. With the branch now indexing `this.doc.getContextBlocks()` (2859) instead of `this.doc.document.blocks`, a multi-block selection in a header/footer now converts the header/footer blocks rather than the body blocks at the same indices (previously it mutated unrelated body blocks or read `undefined` past the body array). The change is almost certainly a fix, but it is an unannounced behaviour change for a caller the task doc (docs/tasks/active/20260908-docs-list-level-subtree-todo.md:12-15 lists only the list-level entry points) and the design note do not mention; the same applies to the non-list `marginLeft` pass in handleIndent/handleOutdent.

samples.summary: siblingsOf can hand the planner a container that does not contain the block, silently turning the gesture into a no-op
samples.evidence: packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1641-1644: when `doc.blockParentMap` is stale but the referenced cell still exists (block moved out of the cell since the last layout pass), `cell.blocks` is returned even though it no longer contains `block`. `planSiblingGroup` matches by id (packages/docs/src/model/list-level.ts:86-88), so no change is planned and indent/outdent silently does nothing for that caret — where the pre-change code always moved the caret block itself. The `?? [block]` fallback only covers the missing-cell case.

samples.summary: The indent ceiling is now a shared export but a second hard-coded copy of it remains in the slides PPTX exporter
samples.evidence: packages/slides/src/export/pptx/text.ts:85 `return ` lvl="${Math.min(8, n)}"`;` clamps the same list level to a literal 8 while packages/docs/src/view/clipboard.ts:351 was migrated to the new `MAX_LIST_LEVEL` export (packages/docs/src/model/list-level.ts:7). Slides already depends on the docs package (packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts delegates indent/outdent to the docs text-box editor), so this copy is now the one that will drift if the ceiling ever changes.

samples.summary: markDirty in the cursor-only branch now derives from the merged parent map, changing the id other consumers of the walker mark dirty
samples.evidence: packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1732-1734 switched from `layout.blockParentMap` to `doc.blockParentMap`, so for a caret inside a header/footer table cell the walker's other consumers (style application at packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:3416, toggleList at 3577) now mark the header/footer table's id instead of the cell block's id. Inert today — `dirtyBlockIds` is only passed to the body layout (editor.ts:1527; header/footer layouts at 1540/1554 pass no cache) and packages/docs/src/view/layout.ts:506-529 recomputes table layouts unconditionally — but the marked id is meaningless for the body cache either way, so anyone adding per-cell line caching would inherit a wrong key.

finding.summary: New crash path: TextEditor.siblingsOf resolves the parent table with doc.getBlock (throws), unlike the editor.ts twin which deliberately uses findBlock
finding.evidence: packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:2890 `const tableBlock = this.doc.getBlock(info.tableBlockId);` — `getCellInfo` reads `getActiveLayout().blockParentMap`, which is only as fresh as the last layout pass. This file already treats that map as routinely stale: packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:2971-2978 wraps arrow handling in try/catch with the comment "Stale blockParentMap data (e.g. table rows removed by remote edit)", and `Doc.getBlock` throws when the id no longer resolves (packages/docs/src/model/document.ts:220-266 / findBlock returning undefined). `handleTab` (2699-2707), `handleIndent` (2762) and `handleOutdent` (2779) have no such guard, and before this change the cursor-only path never consulted the parent map at all — so a Tab/Cmd+] with the caret in a cell of a table deleted by a peer now throws out of the keydown handler mid-gesture. The diff's own editor.ts copy documents the opposite choice (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1632-1641, `findBlock`, "rather than throw out of the middle of an indent gesture"); the fix belongs on the new text-editor.ts code (use findBlock + optional chaining).

verdict.reason: The code is exactly as described: text-editor.ts:2893 resolves the parent table with the throwing `this.doc.getBlock(info.tableBlockId)` from a layout-time `blockParentMap` (getCellInfo, 3666-3671), while the twin helper in editor.ts:1636-1645 uses non-throwing `doc.findBlock` with a comment explicitly justifying that choice ("would throw out of the middle of an indent gesture"). document.ts:200-216 confirms `getBlock` throws while findBlock (221-231) returns undefined. The reaching entry points handleTab (2680), handleIndent (2760) and handleOutdent (2777) have no try/catch, unlike handleArrow (2971-2978), which wraps the identical stale-map + getBlock pattern (3045-3046) with the comment "Stale blockParentMap data (e.g. table rows removed by remote edit)"; text-editor.ts:4634-4639 states the same invariant ("must degrade to the block-wide range rather than throw"). I did find a mitigating guard — handleKeyDown:1024-1036 relocates the caret when `doc.findBlock(cursor.position.blockId)` fails — which blocks the reviewer's literal "table deleted by a peer" narration, since the caret's cell block would also be gone. But that guard only establishes the caret block resolves, not that the stale-mapped tableBlockId does, and this file's own maintainers kept a try/catch for this throw class downstream of the same guard, so it does not make the path provably unreachable. Presence claim verified; no clean already-guarded or not-present ground.

finding.summary: editor.ts's new `siblingsOf` resolves cell info from the body-only `layout.blockParentMap`, so a caret inside a header/footer table cell now gets the wrong sibling array and toolbar indent/outdent silently no-ops there
finding.evidence: `recomputeLayout` computes `layout` from `doc.document.blocks` only (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1523-1533) and merges header/footer parentage into a *separate* map that it hands to the model (`doc.setBlockParentMap(mergedParentMap)`, editor.ts:1573-1580). The new `siblingsOf` (editor.ts:1618-1627, reached from the cursor-only fallback at editor.ts:1711-1712) looks the block up in `layout.blockParentMap` — the body map. For a list item inside a *header* table cell that lookup misses, so `siblingsOf` returns `doc.getContextBlocks()` (the header's top-level blocks), an array that does not contain the block. `planSiblingGroup` then finds no selected id in it and returns no changes (packages/docs/src/model/list-level.ts:63-83), so `applyListLevelChanges` writes nothing — where the old code indented the block unconditionally. The rest of editor.ts uses the region-inclusive map for exactly this reason (`doc.blockParentMap.get(cursor.position.blockId)`, editor.ts:4041, 4074, 4187), and text-editor.ts's equivalent helper deliberately uses the *active* layout (`getActiveLayout().blockParentMap`, packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:3650-3655), which is why the header case works on the Tab / Cmd+] path but not on the toolbar path. Fix belongs on the new code: use `doc.blockParentMap` (or the active-region layout) in `siblingsOf`. Header/footer table cells are a supported caret location per the comment at editor.ts:1568-1572; the added tests cover header lists and body-table lists but never a header-table cell.

verdict.reason: The code is not as described. `siblingsOf` (editor.ts:1636-1645) performs no map lookup at all — it receives `cellInfo` as a parameter, and its doc comment (editor.ts:1624-1630) explicitly requires that it come from the merged `doc.blockParentMap` for precisely the header/footer-cell reason the finding claims was overlooked. Its only caller, the cursor-only fallback, does exactly that: `const cellInfo = doc.blockParentMap.get(block.id)` at editor.ts:1732 (comment at 1729-1731). `recomputeLayout` populates that merged map with header and footer cell parentage (editor.ts:1573-1580, fed by layout.ts:511-513), and `doc.findBlock` resolves header/footer table blocks (document.ts:221-231), so a caret in a header table cell yields the cell's `blocks` array, not `getContextBlocks()`. The asserted silent no-op path therefore does not exist; the finding's proposed fix is already the code in the tree.
